title: Safeword report
description: Signed by the pair's Sub device (request signing) and posted to /v1/pairs/{pairIdHash}/safeword when the Sub uses their safeword, so an Owner who was offline learns of it. Carries only when it happened and one of two moods; no text, character name or world. A report whose at is older than the stored one leaves the stored safeword unchanged.

mood.description: stop: the Sub is okay and wants it to stop; checkin: the Sub asks to be checked on.
